narrative: USD/JPY tumbles 2.0% to 155.53 after Governor Ueda says rate hikes remain on the table at every meeting, including this month, reinforced by a five-month-high Services PMI; markets price a 77% probability of action on September 18. Gold gains 2.6% to $4,530.20 and DXY slips 0.7% to 98.91 on broad dollar softness. Equities stay firm — SPX +1.1%, VIX at 14.6 — even as the SOFR-TONA carry compresses to 268bp (3.66% vs 0.98%). Watch the BoJ September 18 decision for confirmation.
